fact: SeyID's ID-Wallet page says holders of a valid ID Card from the Department of Immigration and Civil Status and a SeyID can obtain a Virtual ID Card, in partnership with that Department.
SeyID's Minor ID page says parents and guardians can activate a child's virtual identity card in ID-Wallet, which carries a QR code for presentation.
The Seychelles ICS assigns a National Identity Number and, from 17 September 2024, issues permit holders a virtual ID card on the SeyID platform; Seychellois abroad can also register for it.
source_slug: 2024-09-18 Launch of New Digital Solutions for Public Services

fact: ID Tech, citing Seychelles News Agency, reports SeyID was officially launched on 1 November 2022 and from 17 September 2024 is mandatory as a virtual ID for new work permit holders, valid for the permit's duration.
source_slug: 2024-09-18 Seychelles Makes Digital ID Mandatory for Work Permit Holders

fact: Biometric Update, citing a WISeKey announcement, reports the SeyID digital identity platform has been delivered and deployed for the Seychelles government, holding the National ID in a wallet with a QR-verifiable digital ID card.
The Seychelles Department of Immigration and Civil Status says holding a valid National Identity Card, with a National Identity Number, is mandatory for all residents and serves as proof of identity.
The ICS says it issues the National Identity Number, and permit holders from 17 September 2024 receive a SEYID virtual ID, which has existed since 2022.
The Department of Immigration and Civil Status issues National Identity Cards valid for ten years, free on first issue for Seychellois and SCR300 for expatriates, per its FAQ.
The Civil Status Division prepares and issues Identity Cards to all residents under the Civil Status Act and the ID Card Act.
